w: 50th Pramukh Varni din celebration More than 14,000 devotees assembled to witness the 50th celebration of Swamishri’s Presidentship of the BAPS (For details see.. 50th PRAMUKH VARNI DIN )
ph: Swamishri in an illustrious mood, Mumbai
Praising the doership of God during his blessings

w: Swamishri performed his morning puja at the Radha Krishna Mandir. At 11.00 am he arrived at the newly established Satsang Bhavan and performed pujan and arti of the all - in - one murti of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and guru parampara. Swamishri then sanctified the first floor, ground floor and basement and blessed the satsang assembly. The evening assembly was held at the Radha Krishna Mandir.

At 9.00 am, Swamishri arrived at the 33-acre site for the Bhumi-pujan ceremony of the proposed BAPS Cultural and Social Complex. The Vedic rituals of the maha-puja were performed by Swamishri and devotees. Swamishri 'broke' the ground with an iron bar and thus performed the Bhumi-pujan and ground-breaking ritual. Finally, in his blessings Swamishri said, "By the will of God and Yogiji Maharaj and the efforts of sadhus and devotees we have acquired a nice area of land. The road nearby leads to Gangasagar, hence we are on the road towards a great holy place. A holy place is where God is installed. Similarly, this too will become a great holy place where hundreds of thousands will come for darshan and attain peace and happiness ..." More than 1,000 devotees had attended the function.

The evening assembly was held at the renowned Kalamandir Hall. More than 1,100 devotees had assembled for the program to honor the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj. After the preliminary bhajans and speeches, a lively procession of Harikrishna Maharaj placed in a palanquin, commenced in the hall. Finally, Swamishri blessed the esteemed gathering.

At noon, a 5-day (17 to 21 June) Bal-Kishore Satsang Shibir of participants from Mumbai commenced after Pramukh Swami Maharaj's arrival in Tithal (Kosamba). In all, 195 kishores, 100 kishoris, 111 balaks, 75 balikas and 50 bal karyakars were present. The theme of the shibir was "What Can't be Done for Pramukh Swami Maharaj!" During the morning and evening sessions, Swamishri inspired the participants through his blessings and guidance. Senior sadhus delivered speeches on 'God's Existence', 'Matchless Guru', 'Shriji Maharaj is Present Today', etc. The balaks and kishores performed a number of skits, namely: Man's achievements, A happy man's clothes, Vajesinh Bapu's hukkah, 'Two things I have done...,' Sura Khachar's niyam, etc. The 5-day program was also interlaced with debates and question-answer sessions with Swamishri.

The aim of Swamishri’s satsang tour in USA is to celebrate the BAPS Centenary Year. Today the first festive celebration was going to be held in Chicago at the Sear’s Center. The theme was Sahaj Anand (Natural Divine Joy), which is the mission and message of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and the Guru Parampara. The programme included audio-visual presentations, cultural programmes, drama presentations and speeches. It commenced at 5.00 pm with the singing of the shanti paath. Thereafter the theme of Sahaj Anand was explained with regards to man’s quest for enduring happiness. The programme content was as follows:  Traditional dance: Akshar Purushottam ki Jai ho  Speech by Viveksagar Swami: Principle of Akshar Purushottam propagated by Shastriji Maharaj  Video: 100 years of BAPS  Three youths explained the significance and relevance of mandirs today and for the future  Video on BAPS Mandir  Speech by Ishwarcharan Swami on Yogiji Maharaj  Video on BAPS socio-spiritual activities.  Skit on how satsang activities sculpt the lives of people  A traditional dance based on the lyrics ‘Shatabdi ãvi...’  Video about the ongoing social activities by BAPS inspired by Pramukh Swami Maharaj. The era of fulfilment  Speech by Anandswarup Swami on Swamishri’s contributions and greatness  Swamishri arrived on stage amidst a standing ovation and welcome from 11,000 devotees and well-wishers in the arena  Swamishri was welcomed by a traditional dance by youths on the theme of five elements, namely, earth, water, fire, air and space. The dance culminated in a fireworks display on stage. The entire congregration waved the BAPS flags creating a spiritually exciting and charged atmosphere.  On behalf of all the devotees of North America Satsang Mandal senior sadhus Tyagvallabh Swami, Ishwarcharan Swami and Viveksagar Swami offered a garland of pearls to Swamishri. Thereafter all sadhus offered a 100 ft long garland of flowers.  Swamishri was honoured by dignitaries: Indian Consul General H.E. Ashok Kumar Atri, Illinois State Senator Hon. John Milner. Senator Milner declared that the portion of Illinois Route 59 between Highway number 64 and Army Trail Road would now be named as ‘Pramukh Swami Maharaj Road’. He said that it was in honour of Swamiji’s global socio-spiritual services to mankind. Thereafter State Representative of Illinois Hon. Randy Ramey honoured Swamishri and he declared 17 June 2007 as ‘BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha Centenary Day’. Other dignitaries who received Swamishri’s blessings were Illinois State representatives Mr Paul Froelich, Hoffman Estates Village Mayor Williams McLeod, who presented a Key to the City to Swamishri, Deputy Mayor of Hoffman Estate Village Cary Collins and CEO of Alexis Medical Center Mr Edward Goldberg.  Swamishri blessed the sponsorer of the programme Shri Narendrabhai Patel and his sons. This was followed by a colourful and traditional centenary dance.  Vivekmurti Swami announced BAPS volunteers and professionals who would dedicate their voluntery services in times of calamity and need. A spotlight was shone on the BAPS volunteers as the announcement was made: 100 volunteers, 100 pharmacists and nurses, 100 engineers and architects, 100 doctors, 100 businessmen, 100 teachers and musicians, 100 ideal children and teenagers, 100 ideal parents and 100 sadhus. The invited dignitaries and guests received the announcement with generous applause. The assembly climaxed with Swamishri’s blessings, “I congratulate all of you who have come here in great numbers. You have come from India to earn and run businesses but along with that do not forget our religion, values and shastras. Never forget the moral instructions given therein. Life is sustained through genuine things. Our culture and religion are our breath. The more we consolidate them in life the more progress and peace we will attain in life. And one must also contribute to the progress of the country and serve it by abiding by the laws. The more we sacrifice and serve others and the more we respect others, the more will our personal progress be. “Bhagwan Swaminarayan came on earth and initiated 500 paramhansas and hundreds of thousands of devotees. He gave one instruction to all: Sarva jiva hitavaha (Do good of all). He has written in the Shikshapatri wishing the good of all people, animals and birds. He preached that along with fulfilling one’s mundane responsibilities reading the spiritual texts will give inner peace, knowledge of atma and Paramatma, liberation and God’s happiness.” Swamishri further elaborated upon the offering of bhakti as the means to transcend maya, having faith in the supremacy of God’s powers and obeying his word. In conclusion the youths performed a dance on the lyrics “Akshar Purushottamnã dankã…” Swamishri waved the BAPS flag and was also joined by the audience of 11,500 people waving small flags and a shower of confetti that exploded in all corners of the Sears Center arena. The grand finale surcharged the air with divinity and joyous celebration.
When some of the special features of America came up in conversation, Prakash Patel of Dharmaj said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Here you can even get a radar that jams the police radar."
Picking up on this, Hemangbhai Mukhi said, "Bapa! Please give us that kind of radar too, so that lust, anger, greed and attachment are all jammed."
Swamishri immediately said, "It has already been given, but if you miss it, what can God do? Maharaj has given the Shikshapatri. If you live according to its rules, every fault will be jammed."

Swamishri compared the radar, a new form of the Sudarshan Chakra, with the rules of the Shikshapatri. But Prakashbhai said, "Bapa! What I am saying is, just as the police radar gets jammed, give us a radar such that even if we do nothing, everything is averted."
Matching their humour, Swamishri himself said jokingly, "You two should set up a factory for it." (Prakash and Hemang)
Prakashbhai said, "Why don't you set up such a factory yourself?"
Swamishri said, "We do not have a factory for breaking God's rules."
This is the unique quality of the Gunatit Satpurush, the matchless follower and protector of the rules given by God: even in jest he cannot imagine talk of breaking those rules.

Today Mahant Swami Maharaj came early, at 5.35, and sat on the puja stage in the Swaminarayan Haveli to do his puja. After the puja was over, Swamishri had the speaker apologise to everyone on his behalf: "Today we came early, and if it caused you any trouble, please forgive us." Everyone was deeply moved.
Swamishri went on, "There is jet lag, so I do not realise." Swamishri's eyes and hands were still asking for forgiveness.
During breakfast too, words of apology flowed from Swamishri's lips.
Swamishri said, "I do not want to be early; it just happens."
This sentence settled the question in many minds of why Swamishri wakes so early!
After breakfast was over, Mahant Swami Maharaj gave the tissue he was holding to Amrutkirtandas Swami and said, "Here, you had a wish, didn't you! That wish is fulfilled."

On hearing this, Amrutkirtandas Swami exclaimed "Oh!" in awe. And speaking to the sadhus, he said, "Yesterday, the devotees and youths who do seva with the pujari swami said to me, 'We do not get much benefit, so it would be good if we could get something sanctified by Swamishri.' This morning I told Adarshmunidas Swami about this. I thought that after Swamishri had breakfast, we would give these devotees and youths the saffron tissue with which he wipes his hands. But after breakfast was over, Swamishri did not wipe his hands with a tissue but with a handkerchief. He needed to wipe his hands again. I held out the tissue. That time too Swamishri wiped his hands with the handkerchief. I thought, well, now this tissue will not become prasad. But Swamishri put his hand on the sadhus' heads and blessed them. And he himself asked for a tissue to wipe his hands. And knowing all hearts, he even said, 'Your wish is fulfilled.'"
It is as if Swamishri has let his divine powers loose.
Today, when Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the satsang shibir, a quiz about his preferences had been arranged. The answers Swamishri gave in it are presented below:
Question 1: What is your favourite game?
Swamishri answered, "Football."
Question 2: What is your favourite kirtan?
"Swamiji to mahapratapi..."
Question 3: If you were to offer a sweet to Thakorji, which sweet would you offer?
"Mesub."
Question 4: If you were to offer a flower to Thakorji, which flower would you choose?
"Mogra (Arabian jasmine)."
Question 5: In your view, which virtue of Yogi Bapa is important?
"Seeing virtues in others."
Question 6: Which is your favourite Vachanamrut?
"Gadhada III 5."
Question 7: In your view, what is one extraordinary characteristic of Pramukh Swami Maharaj?
"Forbearance."
Question 8: Of which murti do you do manasi puja?
"Of the London murti."
This answer got the most applause.
Question 9: Which is your favourite place?
Swamishri said, "Gondal."
Now a question and answer session with Swamishri began.
Swamishri was asked, "What should we do so that our colour in satsang keeps getting deeper and deeper?"

Swamishri said, "Think about the attainment. There is no match for Maharaj and Swami whom we have met. They are beyond the beyond. There is no authority above them. Shriji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj came to this earth, and this universe is the dirtiest place. Maharaj came to earth with Aksharbrahman, in whose pores countless universes float."
Swamishri was asked, "Swami! Will you tell us an incident that will increase the unity among us more and more?"

Swamishri described an incident: "Yogi Bapa was in Nadiad, and on learning that two brothers who were not satsangis had become reconciled, Yogiji Maharaj was extremely pleased and fed them pendas and was ready to prostrate before them!" Then he said, "They were not devotees, and yet Yogi Bapa liked their unity. He likes unity even among those outside. So why would he not like it within satsang? If we live in unity, no problem will arise at all. In unity we should not make demands, but think about what we should do. If we have no expectations of others, unity remains."
Swamishri was asked the third and final question: "Swami! We are forgetful. We will not remember all this, so please give us one message that we will follow all our lives."
Swamishri answered in one word: "Ghar sabha." And he said, "In it all problems will be solved."
After that, as Swamishri was leaving the stage and coming down, he stopped at the rostrum and began to say, "Whatever else we do is effective, but ghar sabha is most effective and in general."

Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the gym to bless the children and little ones. In the next programme, the children were to ask Swamishri questions and Swamishri was to answer yes or no. Those questions and Swamishri's answers are as follows:
Question: Will you be our biggest and very best friend?
Swamishri said, "Yes."
Question: Will you stand at the gate of Akshardham to receive us?
Swamishri said, "Yes."
Question: Are you the same manifest Aksharbrahman as the Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj who came here to London?
Swamishri said, "Yes."
Question: If someone asks us whether we have seen Bhagwan, can we say yes? Because we have
seen you?
Swamishri clenched his fist in a gesture of saying yes with pride and said "Yes."
Everyone was overjoyed to hear such a clear introduction to his form from Swamishri's own lips.
After the walking session was over, Mahant Swami Maharaj was requested: tomorrow there is a sponsored walk, so please fill in a form for this walk too.
On the form, next to the name, Swamishri wrote, "Sadhu Keshavjivandas." And against the address, he wrote, "Akshardham."
That is surely the permanent address of the great sadhu!
